Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

precepts.text: The angel tells Ezra his mind is gone too far in the world, so his thoughts are not our thoughts.
precepts.point: The testimony of the Lord is sure because the prophecies in this Bible are sure; we have a more sure word of prophecy. Did we not go into slavery on ships like the Most High declared through Moses in Deuteronomy 28? We are living proof that the Bible is real.

note.label: Psalm 19: The Perfect Law That Converts the Soul

precepts.why:
The angel tells Ezra, “Thy heart hath gone to far in this world, and thinkest thou to comprehend the way of the most High?” Ezra's mind had gone too far in the world, and he could not comprehend the way of the Most High on his own.

His thoughts are not our thoughts. That is why it takes conversion; a mind gone far into this world cannot just decide to follow the Bible. The law of the Lord is what converts the soul.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 6 The 4 Horsemen

precepts.why: The souls of the prophets speak to the Lord. No, your mama doesn't speak to the Lord; the Lord doesn't want to hear nothing your mama has to say. These are the ones that were murdered and killed, or died following the Bible. Your mama followed Cesare Borgia; God doesn't want to hear nothing she has to say. “Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers,” See that: the souls of the righteous speak to God. All people that die in sin, God ain't listening to them; they ain't saying nothing. So don't make excuses for your grandma: she always read the Bible, but she was worshipping the devil, so God ain't listening to her. “saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when cometh the fruit of the floor of our reward?” See that: the righteous always talk before the Lord. So when you die in this truth, all praises, you are going to talk to the Lord.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 10 The Little Book, Sweet and Bitter

precepts.why: “In the grave the chambers of souls are like the womb of a woman”: what does the womb of a woman bring forth? Life. It is telling you from the grave the soul goes back through the woman again. We will go over that in more detail in another class.

moments.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: The grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness hath it brought up unto this time, and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come. The time of threshing is when Christ returns; until then we are going to be surrounded by evil.

note.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: The angel that was sent unto me, whose name was Uriel, gave me an answer, and said, Thy heart hath gone too far in this world, and thinkest thou to comprehend the way of the most High?

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: Go thy way, weigh me the weight of the fire, or measure me the blast of the wind, or call me again the day that is past.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: What man is able to do that, that thou shouldest ask such things of me?

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: Thine own things, and such as are grown up with thee, canst thou not know; how should thy vessel then be able to comprehend the way of the Highest?

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: The trees of the wood took counsel to make war against the sea, and the floods of the sea took counsel to subdue the woods of the plain; but the thought of the wood was in vain, for the fire came and consumed it, and the thought of the floods came to nought, for the sand stood up and stopped them.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: Thou hast given a right judgment, but why judgest thou not thine own cause? For like as the ground is given unto the wood, and the sea to his floods: even so they that dwell upon the earth may understand nothing but that which is upon the earth.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: It was not my mind to be curious of the high things, but of such as pass by us daily: wherefore Israel is given up as a reproach to the heathen, and for what cause the people whom thou hast loved is given over unto ungodly nations.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: The more thou searchest, the more thou shalt marvel; for the world hasteth fast to pass away.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: The grain of evil seed hath been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness hath it brought up unto this time?

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: The souls of the righteous ask in their chambers, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when cometh the fruit of the floor of our reward?

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: He hath weighed the world in the balance; by measure hath he measured the times, and by number hath he numbered the times; and he doth not move nor stir them, until the said measure be fulfilled.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: Go thy way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she hath fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the birth any longer within her.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: Even so do the chambers of souls in the grave haste to deliver those things that were committed unto them.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: A hot burning oven passed by before me, and when the flame was gone, the smoke remained still; a watery cloud sent down much rain with a storm, and when the stormy rain was past, the drops remained still.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: As the rain is more than the drops, and as the fire is greater than the smoke, so the quantity which is past did far exceed; but the drops and the smoke remained behind.

note.label: 2 Esdras 4: Weigh Me the Weight of the Fire

points: As for the tokens whereof thou askest me, I may tell thee of them in part: but as touching thy life, I am not sent to shew thee.
